definition: Algae Food Products 2.0: next-gen algae as everyday food.

t: 2030 — First product hulls products reach price parity: algae strains c
title: 2030 — First product hulls products reach price parity: algae strains c
definition: 2030 milestone on the Algae Food Products 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First product hulls products reach price parity: algae strains cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the algae strains results have to replicate outside the lab, product logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and flavor work operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed algae strains demonstrations, product logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting flavor work uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Algae Food Products 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Algae Food Products 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Algae Food Products 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 24001 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where algae strains monitoring, product logistics redundancy, or flavor work maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Algae Food Products 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Algae Food Products 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Algae Food Products 2.0 — next-gen algae as everyday food.

Phase 1 — Prove (algae strains): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (product logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (flavor work): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (scale farms): product hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
